name: Salvia divinorum
warning: Heavy uses hard stepped motion, recursive re-tiling and ~7 s page-turn flips. May be disorienting. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: faint lateral lean — the field is dragged sideways along a curved seam (early sway + low seamPull); scene otherwise intact.
Light: the seam pull is clear; the very first mirror fold begins to wake (foldTile ramps from ~0.3 intensity).
Common: visible recursive re-tiling — the scene folds into a couple of mirrored copies of itself — plus the constant sideways pull; still legible as this room.
Strong: deeper fold stack (copies-of-copies), cartoon posterize + Sobel ink lines (late), ~7 s page-turn rolls the whole tiling over; time steps toward ~11 fps.

Heavy: reality break — the fold-tiled scene is flattened into a hard cartoon world (image-derived, not a pasted overlay) with a sliding row of flat dark 'beings' standing in it; the original photo is gone. Comparable in force to DMT breakthrough, in salvia's own re-tiling idiom (realityBreak crossfade, full at Heavy).
